question_text:
Passage: 'DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2024-05, issued on March 15, 2024, reiterates the mandatory conduct of the Barangay Assembly twice a year, as provided under Section 397 of the Local Government Code. The memorandum reminds barangay officials that the assembly must be held within the first quarter and the third quarter of the year. It also requires barangays to submit a report of the assembly proceedings to the DILG provincial office within 15 days after the assembly. Failure to comply may result in administrative charges against the punong barangay and other officials.'

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: Barangay officials must submit a report to the DILG within 15 days.
The DILG memorandum reiterates the requirement for Barangay Assembly twice a year and related compliance measures.
Failure to hold the Barangay Assembly may lead to administrative charges.
The Barangay Assembly must be held in the first and third quarters.
